headline: Nighttime Susuta
title: How to Get Nighttime Susuta | Echoback Landing After Dark | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Nighttime Susuta only appears at Echoback Landing, and only after dark. Go to the beaches on the western coast of Breezy Plains and wait for night. The basic Susuta is grey, while the night form is black and white, almost like a panda. Check the coat before you throw. Sneak up from behind for a backstab bonus, break it first, then use an Aniipod. Did you find yours? Comment below!
description: Nighttime Susuta spawns only at Echoback Landing after dark; it is black and white while the basic Susuta is grey.
